Missing competitor evidence limits certainty. Return one integer score. Supplied evidence only. These are uncalibrated advisory judgments, not measured business results.

trap.instructions: Choose the most material currently explicit constraint; no_clear_trap is not certification. Missing evidence remains a constraint.

criteria.no_clear_trap: No explicit fatal constraint in supplied bounded test; uncertainty still disclosed.
criteria.rights_or_owner: Necessary data rights, accountable owner or authority unavailable.
criteria.unit_economics: Mechanism has no plausible cost/value path or dominant economic contradiction.
criteria.commodity: Claimed novelty is materially covered by an existing offering.
criteria.insufficient_evidence: Evidence too weak to select a viable opportunity or reject alternatives.

angle.instructions: Classify the primary causal mechanism, not marketing language.

criteria.evidence_decision: Improves provenance, verification or decision context.
criteria.continuity_recovery: Reduces downtime, handoff failure or recovery effort.
criteria.delivery_simplification: Simplifies task package, setup, service or execution.

notes.weighting: Eligible score weights .35 novelty +.40 viability +.25 fit; arithmetic only, not outcome prediction. Non-admitted rows remain held; no local pass substitution.
notes.trap_exclusion: Exclude explicit fatal constraints from automatic selection; insufficient_evidence remains held.
